channel.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
channel.desc: Kelly grew up moving from base to base in a military family and always dreamed of a place to call home; then she met Tim, also in the military, and together they now have two beautiful children; with Tim retired, they are ready to finally put down roots, find a home, and give their kids the chance to grow up in a close-knit community while living the East Coast lifestyle they've always imagined; will they find the perfect home to make their dream a reality?
